title: Lafiya deployment ledger record
description: One line of a deployments/<network>.jsonl append-only ledger. See docs/adr/0010-release-manifest-and-compatibility.md and deployments/README.md.

event.description: What kind of on-chain change this record describes.

contract_id.description: The Stellar contract ID (C...) affected by this event.

wasm_sha256.description: sha256 of the wasm now running at contract_id, hex-encoded. Null only for events that don't change code (e.g. admin_transfer).

previous_wasm_sha256.description: sha256 of the wasm this event replaced, for upgrade/migrate events.

tx_hash.description: Hash of the confirmed transaction that performed this event. Null only when the CLI could not capture it (see deployments/README.md); such records must be treated as unverified.

ledger.description: Ledger sequence the transaction was included in, when known.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp the record was appended, RFC 3339.

git_commit.description: git rev-parse HEAD of the repo state used to build the deployed wasm.

release_version.description: workspace.package.version at the time of this event.

operator.description: Identifier of the signer set / identity that authorized this event (e.g. a stellar CLI identity name, or a multisig ceremony id).

prev_record_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact previous JSON line in this file (null for the first record). Makes the file a hash chain: editing or deleting any earlier line invalidates every record after it.
